ModMetaData.name: RimWorld Loading Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Loading Optimizer contributors
ModMetaData.description: Reduces repeated work during startup. Supported definition and type searches and optional Gagarin, Character Editor, Loading Progress and Giddy-Up improvements activate automatically. Configure features in Options / Mod settings / RimWorld Loading Optimizer; changes require restart. Processed-PNG caching is opt-in because its first build can slow loading. Missing or unsupported game, framework and mod versions retain ordinary behavior. This development build has exact Windows GOG and dependency compatibility checks; it is not a public release or a general RimWorld 1.6 compatibility claim.
